_comment: Folio legal docs manifest. Source of truth for the latest ToS / Privacy version: a GitHub Action syncs this into Supabase tos_versions (which the app reads), and it is also bundled into the app as an offline fallback. Bump version + summary when ToS / Privacy changes.

terms.summary_zh: Folio 新增了「大家的便利貼」：每一本書都有一面公開的便利貼牆與書評區。當您在書櫃或共讀室的便利貼勾選「也貼到大家的便利貼」、在大家的便利貼按下「貼上牆」，或儲存書評時，那一則就會公開給同一個社群分區的所有人閱讀；預設署名您的暱稱，貼上牆與書評在 App 允許時也可以選擇匿名。書評一律公開，並會連同您給的評分一起顯示。因此本次補上公開發布的相關條款：您必須確保公開的內容是您本人所寫、沒有侵害他人的著作權或隱私；您隨時可以收回已公開的內容，收回後別人就看不到了，但已經被別人讀過、截圖或抄錄的部分，我們無法回收；在書櫃刪便利貼時選「只刪這裡」或移除整本書，不會刪掉已公開的那一份；刪除帳號時，您公開的便利貼與書評會一併刪除，不會像共讀室的內容那樣匿名保留。若內容經檢舉審查認定違規，我們會將它下架（對應的私人便利貼之後不能再用來公開），並可能暫時停止您在公開牆發布的權限；下架不會影響您自己書櫃裡的私人副本。便利貼牆依閱讀進度分成六段，那是為了避免劇透而設計的，並不是隱私或權限設定。另外，我們依 App 實際運作更正了幾處說明：停權通知一律在 App 內告知，不寄 Email；冷卻期自註冊時起算；停權雜湊只在永久停權時記錄；長期未使用帳號的刪除條件是連續 24 個月未登入且未使用（訂閱中的帳號除外）；訂閱結束後，已套用的書背樣式保留但不能再修改；可以分享出去的是讀後心得分享卡。
terms.summary_en: Folio now includes "Everyone's sticky notes": every book has a public sticky-note wall and a review section. When you tick "Also post to Everyone's sticky notes" on a shelf or co-reading room note, tap "Stick it on the wall" in Everyone's sticky notes, or save a review, that content becomes public to everyone in your community partition; it is attributed to your nickname by default, and notes stuck on the wall and reviews can also be posted anonymously where the app allows. Reviews are always public and are shown with the rating you gave. These Terms therefore now cover public publishing: you must ensure what you publish is written by you and does not infringe anyone's copyright or privacy; you may take published content back at any time and others can then no longer see it, but we cannot recall what others have already read, screenshotted, or copied down; choosing "Delete here only" when deleting a note on your shelf, or removing the whole book, does not delete the published copy; when you delete your account, the notes and reviews you published are deleted too, rather than kept anonymously like co-reading room content. If content is found to breach these Terms following a report review, we will take it down (the corresponding private note can no longer be used to publish it again) and may temporarily suspend your ability to publish to the public wall; a takedown does not affect the private copy on your own shelf. The wall's six reading bands exist to prevent spoilers and are not a privacy or permission setting. We have also corrected several descriptions to match how the app actually works: suspension notices are given in the app only, never by email; cooldowns start at registration; the suspension-evasion hash is recorded only for permanent suspensions; an unused account is deleted after 24 consecutive months with no sign-in and no use (except accounts with an active subscription); once a subscription ends, book-spine styles you applied are kept but can no longer be edited; and what you can share outside the app is the reflection share card.

privacy.summary_zh: 因應「大家的便利貼」上線，本次補上相關的資料處理揭露。新增蒐集：您公開的便利貼與書評（含評分、所在的段落、是否匿名、書名寫法，以及和書櫃私人便利貼的對應關係）、您按的愛心、您解鎖過的段落、您開過哪些書的公開牆與看過哪些書友頁（保留約 2 至 3 天）、進入來源、「這本書的提醒」設定，以及書目回報。請特別注意可見範圍：公開的內容會對同社群分區的所有用戶顯示，預設署名您的暱稱；書評會連同您給的評分一起顯示，其他人也能依評分排序。大家的便利貼不套用心態過濾矩陣：同社群分區內任何心態的用戶，都能點您的暱稱進入書友頁、查看您的個人檔案（依您的隱藏設定），並向您送出好友邀請。匿名發布不顯示暱稱、也不受封鎖影響，但我們為了審核仍保有作者對應關係；檢舉公開便利貼或書評時，快照會包含作者的暱稱、性別、出生年月日、心態與帳號建立時間（匿名作者亦同，不會給檢舉人看）。便利貼所在的段落會透露您發布時大約讀到哪裡。新增用途：依您書櫃的書與同社群分區用戶書櫃的彙總計數（不顯示任何人的身分，也包含沒有使用大家的便利貼的用戶）推薦書籍、產生書籍榜單；輸入書名時的建議另參考全站書櫃的彙總計數。新增揭露：書籍封面圖片由您的裝置直接向 Google Books、Open Library 與國家圖書館載入，對方可取得您的 IP 位址，並能得知您正在看哪一本書的封面。保留期間：公開內容保留到您收回、被下架或帳戶刪除為止，刪除帳戶時會真實刪除；發布或收回時只留一筆不含內容的紀錄、7 天後自動刪除；曾被檢舉或下架的內容，檢舉與處置紀錄中保有內容快照。此外，本次依 App 實際運作校正既有說明，重點如下：RevenueCat 在您登入後就會以帳號識別碼查詢訂閱狀態（不論是否購買）；App 啟動時會連線 Firebase Remote Config，條款文件與官網由 Cloudflare 託管；回覆漂流瓶時，您的暱稱與頭像會顯示給投瓶人；書房按讚的累計數只有房主看得到；您的性別（未隱藏時）會顯示在貼文、貼文詳情與共讀室，年齡（未隱藏時）會顯示在貼文詳情、共讀室、報名資料與個人檔案，都不會因為檢視者的心態而隱藏；登入工作階段紀錄（含 IP）保留到登出或帳戶刪除為止；本平台目前不發送行銷推播，App 內公告可能包含問卷邀請與支持方案介紹。另補揭露既有處理：高嚴重度檢舉（未成年、性相關）會透過 Resend（美國）以電子郵件通知管理人員，內含檢舉人填寫的說明；「大家的便利貼」上線前，我們保存了一份逐人的使用狀態快照（含心態與性別，日後推出新功能時可能再保存），僅供自有後台彙總分析，隨帳戶刪除；每日活躍名單（只含日期與帳號識別碼）在帳戶刪除後仍保留，以免改寫歷史統計。最後，本政策的變更通知方式與服務條款一致：只在 App 內以阻擋式視窗告知，不寄 Email、不推播。
privacy.summary_en: Following the launch of "Everyone's sticky notes", this update adds the related data-processing disclosures. We now collect: the notes and reviews you make public (including the rating, the band each sits in, whether you posted anonymously, how the book's title is written, and the link to the private note on your shelf), the loves you give, the bands you have unlocked, which books' public walls you opened and which reader pages you viewed (kept for about 2 to 3 days), where you entered from, your "Notifications for this book" settings, and catalogue reports. Please note the visibility: public content is shown to all users in your community partition and is attributed to your nickname by default; a review is shown together with the rating you gave, and others can sort reviews by rating. Everyone's sticky notes does not apply the mode filtering matrix: users of any mode in your community partition can tap your nickname to open your reader page, view your profile (subject to your hide settings), and send you a friend request. Anonymous posts show no nickname and are not affected by blocks, but we keep the author association for moderation; when a public note or review is reported, the snapshot includes the author's nickname, gender, date of birth, mode, and account creation time (including for anonymous authors; never shown to the reporter). The band a note sits in reveals roughly how far you had read when you posted it. New purpose: we recommend books and produce book lists from the books on your shelf and aggregate counts of shelves in your community partition (no one's identity is shown, and users who do not use Everyone's sticky notes are counted too); title suggestions while you type also use aggregate counts of shelves across the whole service. New disclosure: book cover images are loaded by your device directly from Google Books, Open Library, and the National Central Library (Taiwan), so they may obtain your IP address and learn which book's cover you are viewing. Retention: public content is kept until you take it back, it is taken down, or your account is deleted, and deleting your account genuinely deletes it; publishing or taking back leaves only a record containing no content, deleted automatically after 7 days; for content that was reported or taken down, the report and moderation records keep a snapshot of it. This update also corrects existing descriptions to match how the app actually works, most importantly: RevenueCat is queried with your account identifier once you sign in (whether or not you purchase); the app connects to Firebase Remote Config when it starts, and our legal documents and website are hosted by Cloudflare; when you reply to a drift bottle, your nickname and avatar are shown to the bottle's author; a room's like count is visible only to its owner; your gender (unless hidden) is shown on posts, in post details, and in co-reading rooms, and your age (unless hidden) in post details, co-reading rooms, application details, and your profile, neither hidden based on the viewer's mode; sign-in session records (including IP address) are kept until you sign out or delete your account; and we do not currently send marketing pushes, while in-app announcements may include survey invitations and introductions to support plans. We also disclose existing practices: for high-severity reports (minor or sexual content) we notify our administrators by email through Resend (United States), including the explanation the reporter wrote; before launching Everyone's sticky notes we kept a per-user snapshot of usage status (including mode and gender; we may keep another when launching new features), used only for aggregate analysis in our own admin console and deleted with your account; and the daily active-user list (only the date and an account identifier) is kept after account deletion so that historical statistics are not rewritten. Finally, changes to this policy are announced the same way as changes to the Terms: only in the app through a blocking modal, never by email or push notification.
